{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm to ensure clean calculation
# This is valid because the missingness is small (2 out of 344) and we are not told to impute
# We are only interested in mean flipper length by species, so we use available data
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
df_mean_flipper = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
df_mean_flipper_sorted = df_mean_flipper.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Get the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = df_mean_flipper_sorted.iloc[0]['species']

# Print the full groupby result for evidence
print(df_mean_flipper_sorted)

# Return the species name
highest_mean_species"}
